title.en: Windows rigid mass matrix GPU probe

intent.zh: 复用设备质心结果。验证刚体质量矩阵子集。
intent.en: Implement a bounded shared-model rigid CRB and symmetric dense mass matrix GPU helper using existing FK/COM device buffers; retain full G02/crb, sparse layout, factorization and solve contracts as planned.

acceptance: GPU computes packed composite rigid inertias and symmetric row-major dense mass matrices, including DOF armature, without CPU physics fallback or intermediate transform reuploads.
Static independent MuJoCo references cover four joint types, branches/static ancestors, zero DOFs and nonzero armature; freeze absolute/relative tolerances at 2e-5 before GPU execution.
Host dimension/capacity/view tests and explicit Windows debug/release GPU tests cover symmetry, ancestor sparsity, analytical kinetic energy, semidefinite inputs and nonfinite-result rejection.
Existing FK/COM/native probes, default/native/CUDA/all-features host tests, fmt and warning-denied Clippy pass; only real evidence updates acceptance.
Preserve all 190 existing contracts, planned product stages and policy rules; auto-commit scoped changes and close Normify with genuine source fingerprints.
note:
质量矩阵已有独立源码文件。架构拆出真实职责叶子。旧66项物理契约迁入计划态core。另立proposed变更管理完整阶段。只在当前代码与测试完成后激活矩阵辅助叶子。不激活完整物理模块。
提交21ad9dd落实刚体质量矩阵辅助。默认133+6、原生139+6、CUDA149+6、全feature159+6均通过。调试与发布各显式通过66项。矩阵四配置通过5或6项；比较1331或1379世界。固定容限2e-5。最大绝对误差1.7808917590400597e-5。解析动能与半正定检查通过。旧刚体与质心回归通过。14项暂存哈希匹配。提交后全feature发布再过6项与1379世界，报告3ede448259344d9aa1faaa4995c2cc55记录真实HEAD及clean工作区。七个产品模块与完整核心继续计划。旧190契约全部保留；66项物理契约只迁移归属。完整阶段提案保持proposed。Linux继续暂缓。
